title: Add an 'exec' fan-out alias to the party-slots parser (with regression guard)
prompt: In src/utils/model/seatSlots.ts, extend parsePartySlots so the seat key 'exec' behaves exactly like the existing 'dps' fan-out key (fans the entry to dps1/dps2/dps3; an explicit dpsN entry still wins). Extend the parser section of scripts/seat-slots/prove-seat-slots.ts with asserts covering: 'exec=sonnet5@xhigh' fans to all three executor seats, and 'exec=sonnet5,dps2=fable' keeps dps2=fable. The whole seat-slots suite must stay green.
